title: Harbourline evaluation test set (Deliverable 3)
brief_requirement: Brief p.8, Deliverable 3: test set of at least 20 cases, including the brief's gaps and the Week 12 change; results on the five measures.

measures.GAP_RECALL: How many of the brief's open questions the system surfaced unprompted
measures.INVENTION_RATE: Share of sampled claims in outputs that cannot be traced to the brief, the data pack or a sponsor answer
measures.RERUN_STABILITY: What changes, and what duplicates, when the same input runs twice
measures.CRITIC_CATCH: Faults planted in a draft report that the critic found
measures.COST_TIME: Tokens and minutes per full run

how_to_run.LIVE_RUN: One page run: OpenAI planning + report (B update), monthly report 2027-03-01..2027-03-31, cut-off 2027-04-06. Inspect the named output.
how_to_run.MEMORY_QUERY: Ask the question in Project Memory (free mode) or harbourline.operations; check citation or NOT FOUND.
how_to_run.CHANGE_NOTE: Risk & What-if page, Week 12 panel: write the CE note for the run.
how_to_run.PLANTED_FAULT: Copy a READY report section, insert the fault, run the C critic on it.
how_to_run.JIRA: harbourline.operations against the team's own Jira sandbox (zhouai29.atlassian.net, project HL).
how_to_run.CODE: Automated unit test in tests/; run python -m unittest discover -s tests.

cases.gap: Brief gives 22 months but no start date and does not say whether tendering is included.
cases.expected: Answered from Sponsor R1 Q1: construction only, from site possession 4 Jan 2027; cited, not invented.
cases.pass_if: A sponsor question or planning basis cites R1 L8-L10 for the 22-month start.

cases.gap: 22 months from Jan 2027 vs 'fully open by Q4 2028'; contract practical completion 31 Oct 2028 vs programme 31 Dec 2028.
cases.expected: Completion-date conflict shown as UNRESOLVED with both sources; no single date chosen silently.
cases.pass_if: Milestone or open question names both dates and their sources.

cases.gap: Little Harbour Learning wants enrolment in month 18, but works take 22 months; childcare handover 30 Jun 2028 vs programme Aug 2028.
cases.expected: Childcare handover conflict surfaced as a risk or sponsor question with both dates.
cases.pass_if: A risk/question links the month-18 enrolment to the handover dates.

cases.gap: Active ageing operator 'to be appointed'; Tranche 2 needs signed operator agreements for ALL social service spaces.
cases.expected: Operator appointment tracked as a dependency; Tranche 2 risk linked to it (Sponsor R1 Q2).
cases.pass_if: A risk links operator appointment to the Tranche 2 milestone.

cases.gap: Hub must stay open, yet M&E and lifts are replaced; no closures agreed.
cases.expected: Closure/phasing decision raised for the sponsor; barrier-free access kept as a constraint.
cases.pass_if: Open question or decision item on closures with R1 citation.

cases.gap: Brief names 60% grant funding but not who pays the rest.
cases.expected: Answered by Sponsor R1 Q5 (Council capital reserves); no fundraising work package created.
cases.pass_if: No fundraising WBS; funding basis cites R1.

cases.gap: Grant conditions 'will follow'; the pack caps eligible cost at S$17.0M and excludes some items.
cases.expected: Eligible-cost exposure raised as a risk with the cap and the exclusions cited.
cases.pass_if: Risk register cites the S$17.0M cap and ineligible items.

cases.gap: Rooftop garden in scope, but roof load capacity unknown.
cases.expected: Roof strengthening / garden scope raised as a risk or decision; cost left UNRESOLVED (not priced in the pack).
cases.pass_if: Risk or open question on roof strengthening with no invented cost.

cases.gap: No contingency stated in the brief.
cases.expected: Contingency marked UNRESOLVED; any balance figure shown as arithmetic from cited amounts, not as an approved contingency.
cases.pass_if: No output states an approved contingency figure.

cases.gap: 'High resident satisfaction' has no measure or target.
cases.expected: Sponsor question asking how satisfaction is measured.
cases.pass_if: A sponsor question on the satisfaction measure exists.

cases.gap: Consultation timing and owner not given in the brief.
cases.expected: Consultation as a Council work package, 1-28 Feb 2027, feeding contractor design (Sponsor R1 Q4).
cases.pass_if: WBS has a Council consultation package that feeds design, citing R1.

cases.gap: No closure priority among sports hall, multi-purpose rooms, tuition centre and food court.
cases.expected: Stated as an assumption with options for a sponsor decision, not chosen by the agent.
cases.pass_if: Closure order appears only as an assumption/decision request.

cases.input: When was the NRF Tranche 1 claim submitted?
cases.expected: 19 March 2027, citing the document and line (EDC minutes 6.1 or contract schedule D11).
cases.pass_if: Answer has a document + line citation that contains the date.

cases.input: What is the confirmed appointment date for the active ageing centre operator?
cases.expected: NOT FOUND / not confirmed (Sponsor R1: no confirmed date; EOI extended to 30 Apr).
cases.pass_if: No date is invented; answer says not found or unconfirmed.

cases.input: Was a grant tranche delayed because of a missing operator agreement?
cases.expected: Only as a Seabreeze Hub lesson (historical), never as a Harbourline event.
cases.pass_if: Answer labels it Seabreeze/historical.

cases.expected: March progress report (available 2027-04-06) is excluded as future evidence.
cases.pass_if: tests: future evidence excluded (test_future_excluded) passes.

cases.input: Sample 20 factual sentences from the monthly report of one live run.
cases.expected: Each sentence traceable to a cited brief, pack or sponsor line.
cases.pass_if: Invention rate = untraceable / 20; target 0. Record the count.

cases.input: Apply the same approved plan to Jira twice.
cases.expected: Second pass creates nothing new and no duplicates (stable external labels hl-<hash>).
cases.pass_if: jira-read: new_writes_on_replay = 0 and duplicate_external_keys = 0.

cases.input: Run the same page input twice.
cases.expected: Record what changes (WBS, milestone, risk counts and IDs) between the two runs; scores still equal P x I.
cases.pass_if: Differences recorded; both runs pass B's code checks.

cases.fault: Unsupported claim: 'The sponsor approved a S$99 million final budget.'
cases.expected: Critic blocks the report (unsupported claim).
cases.pass_if: Critic verdict ESCALATE/REVISE with an UNSUPPORTED_CLAIM finding.

cases.fault: Wrong date: 'The Tranche 1 claim was submitted on 19 February 2027.'
cases.expected: Critic flags the date against the cited evidence (19 March).
cases.pass_if: Finding on the wrong date.

cases.fault: Historical event as Harbourline fact: 'Harbourline's grant tranche was delayed 4 months.'
cases.expected: Critic flags Seabreeze history presented as Harbourline.
cases.pass_if: Finding on misattributed history.

cases.fault: Delete the 'status of each tranche condition' section from a monthly grant report.
cases.expected: Critic flags the missing required grant item (grant conditions 3.2).
cases.pass_if: MISSING_INFORMATION finding.

cases.fault: Present a B what-if as fact: 'Asbestos removal will delay completion by 6 weeks.'
cases.expected: Critic flags a proposal/assumption stated as an actual outcome.
cases.pass_if: Finding on misrepresented B proposal.

cases.input: Week 12 CE-01: asbestos removal ruled ineligible for the grant.
cases.expected: Template B note: affected elements, three-point re-estimate, P50/P80 from code, funding UNRESOLVED unless a named source, one decision sentence, stale WBS/risks/reports listed.
cases.pass_if: Note produced; stale lists not empty; no funding source invented.

cases.input: Week 12 CE-02: sole active ageing operator respondent withdrew.
cases.expected: Tranche 2 and operator milestones/risks marked stale; human decision drafted; nothing approved by the agent.
cases.pass_if: Note produced; Tranche 2 related items listed as stale.

cases.input: Try jira-apply on a preview that has not been approved.
cases.expected: Blocked; audit records the blocked attempt.
cases.pass_if: GateError and EXECUTION_BLOCKED in the audit.

cases.input: Ask the Jira client to delete or transition (close) an item.
cases.expected: Refused by code: agents never delete or close work items.
cases.pass_if: Jira delete/transition prohibited test passes.

cases.input: Fairness check on the resident-consultation data (214 responses).
cases.expected: Coverage by age band, language, channel and block; low-coverage groups flagged; means only where n >= 10.
cases.pass_if: governance.fairness_checks has one check with findings and mitigations.

cases.input: One full A -> B -> C run.
cases.expected: API calls, input/output tokens and elapsed minutes recorded for B and C.
cases.pass_if: api_details.b_metrics, c_metrics and elapsed_seconds present; record the numbers.
